overlay.hostPaused: The host has paused — click to join

overlay.episodeChanged: The host changed the episode — click to continue

ageGate.title: Age confirmation
ageGate.text: This video cannot be embedded without age confirmation (YouTube age restriction). By confirming, you agree that you are 18 or older.
ageGate.waitHost: YouTube blocked the video — waiting for the host to confirm 18+
ageGate.declined: This video is unavailable without age confirmation
ageGate.jobLost: The task was lost, try again
ageGate.queued: Waiting in the server queue… {sec} s
ageGate.hostEnabled: The host enabled 18+ content. Reload the page if you are ready to confirm your age.

sys.episodeChanged: The host switched to Season {season}, Episode {episode}
sys.viewerHelp: When the host starts the video, you need to start it on your side manually (button or space). After that you can press “Sync”, and the site will adjust you automatically if you fall behind by more than {n} seconds.

voice.title: Voice chat
voice.confirmText: Do you really want to start voice chat? The browser will ask for microphone access.
voice.micLost: The microphone was disconnected — call ended

fullTryLater.one: The call is already full (max {n} person) — try later.
fullTryLater.other: The call is already full (max {n} people) — try later.

voice.btWarn: Microphone “{label}” is a Bluetooth headset: it may make the movie sound “like in a tin can”. Choose another microphone in 🎚️ Sound settings.

voiceSettings.title: Sound settings
voiceSettings.processingHint: If your voice sounds “like in a tin can”, try turning it off. With speakers (no headphones) it is better to keep it on.
voiceSettings.levelHint: The bar shows how others hear you. When you speak normally it should reach at least the middle. If it barely moves, raise the volume. Works during a call.
voiceSettings.duck: Lower the video volume while someone is speaking
voiceSettings.statsEmpty: Shown once you join the call.
voiceSettings.btHint: A Bluetooth microphone is selected. While it is on, the headphones switch to headset mode and the movie sounds “like in a tin can”. Choose the laptop or a wired microphone and the headphones stay in normal mode.
